thresholds.unnecessaryDetour: alternative that adds > 10 m of confirmed pavé, or saves < 50 m of weighted pavé (confirmed + 0.65 × probable), or costs > 180 s per 100 m of weighted pavé saved
thresholds.stability: shifted endpoints by ≈22 m; same decision and chosen route within 30 m of the unshifted chosen route for ≥ 80% of its length
